items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: I played with Louis Keppert's band there.

ctx.x: You said Louis Keppert. I played with Louis Keppert's band there. The whole band there? Yeah. We had Willis Addergo. Oh, yeah. Oh, I forget the other fellas was in the band. But I know them two. It was Willis Addergo and then Freddie Keppert. I was playing that one.
